confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer are informed by a [June 2026 Numbeo snapshot](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Cairo-Egypt) and an [August restaurant price index](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/egypt/cairo-egypt/restaurants/). Cocktail and wine estimates use premiums over beer informed by a [Cairo bar price guide](https://lorenzigo.com/best-bars-pubs-cairo-egypt/). Accommodation estimates are holistic and uncertain; drink prices and exchange rates also vary.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates primarily use Cairo data. Accommodation estimates draw on general knowledge of budget travel in North African capitals and Cairo's tourism demand.
